description: Agent updated summary memory for article publish status but forgot to close memory-service tasks 17 & 24. User had to discover and fix 3 days later.

label.annotator_notes: User confirmed articles 24 & 25 published on 5/25. Agent updated the summary memory (memory_id 70, '25篇全已发') but never called update_task(status='done') for task 17 (article-25) or task 24 (update-publish-status). Tasks stayed in_progress for 3 days until user noticed in Codex session and had to explicitly ask agent to fix. This is a classic incomplete_followthrough: the agent understood the intent, did part of the work (memory update), but missed the downstream obligation (task closure). The remediation session itself scored drift=0, but its existence proves the upstream session had undetected cognitive drift.

failure_fixture.root_failure: Agent updated summary memory but did not close engram tasks 17 & 24
secondary_failures: state_desync between memory layer and task layer

root.evidence: Agent updated summary memory (memory_id 70, '25篇全已发') but never called update_task(status='done') for tasks 17 & 24. Execution path diverged from complete closure — partial state update created invisible debt.

secondary.evidence: Tasks stayed in_progress for 3 days with no alert. Agent reported success in memory layer while task layer remained stale.

cross_session.upstream_action: updated summary memory with '25篇全已发'

diagnosis.why_eval_missed: In-session drift score was 0 — every tool call aligned with the stated goal. The failure is cross-session: the upstream session on 5/25 closed without completing downstream obligations. No existing metric captures 'this session should not have been necessary.'
diagnosis.replay_oracle: After user confirms article publication, does the agent close ALL related entities (memory + task + progress) in the same session, or leave orphaned in_progress tasks?
ambiguities: Whether track_progress(status='done') alone should be sufficient to close a task, or whether explicit update_task is always required — this is an engram API design question, not purely an agent behavior question.

goals.raw: 有个问题，codex刚看了memory-service说有两个任务还是in_process，没有done。文章24和25我已经发布了

observable_targets: close memory-service tasks 17 and 24 to done status
